cover.sgdbWhatTitle: What Is SteamGridDB and Why Is an API Key Required?
cover.sgdbWhatBody: SteamGridDB is a high-quality open image archive for games. To prevent abuse and allow searching directly from your library, a free personal access key (Token) is required.
cover.sgdbStep1: Go to the official SteamGridDB page and sign in (with Steam or Discord).
cover.sgdbStep2: On the page that opens, click "Create API Key" and copy your key.
cover.sgdbStep3: Paste the key into the field below and press "Save and Search".
cover.sgdbGetKey: Get Your Free API Key Here
cover.sgdbLibBody: SteamGridDB is an open platform hosting official and community-made portrait covers (2:3) and spotlight banners (Hero) for video games. The images you pick are applied to your library instantly.

playtime.whyTitle: Why can't Epic Games data be fetched automatically?
playtime.whyDesc: Epic Games Store stores playtime only in closed telemetry on its own servers and does not provide a REST/GraphQL or OAuth API that third-party clients (Heroic, GOG, etc.) can access. Enter your previous Epic playtime here once, and future game sessions will be added on top of it.

manage.epicDataTitle: Why Can't Epic Games Data Be Retrieved Automatically?
manage.epicDataP1: Epic Games Store stores playtime only in its own private server-side telemetry system and provides no REST/GraphQL or OAuth API that third-party clients (Heroic, GOG Galaxy, etc.) can access.
manage.epicDataP2: When you launch a game through the launcher, session durations are recorded locally. You can add the time you previously spent in Epic Games once via the "Edit Time" button above and keep accumulating from where you left off.
